decisive_items: apex of the heart located at the right side of the chest
hepatic dullness that was located in the left subcostal region
right atrium and right ventricle laid on the left side and the left atrium and left ventricle on the right side with its apex directed to the right
response.rationale: Physical exam and echocardiogram show dextrocardia with situs inversus, explaining the ECG artifact; RBBB is a secondary finding after electrode correction.

rejected.why: Describes the ECG pattern but not the underlying anatomical reversal that causes the initial ECG findings.
